description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a UI fragment that contains a LogView for displaying log data and manages its layout and behavior within an Android application.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a log view and handles its layout, styling, and text change events.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on new log entries, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
